global: Creamy, golden-brown tonkotsu broth with floating noodles and toppings in a white ceramic bowl featuring red and green geometric patterns. Chashu pork and pale yellow menma bamboo shoots sit in the broth on a wooden table with warm orange-brown grain.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm orange-brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle natural texture variations.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with red and green geometric patterns and Chinese characters along its rim.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy, golden-brown, and glossy, with visible noodles and toppings floating on its surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: tender, pale pink slices with marbled fat, slightly curled edges, and glistening surface from broth.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a soft, fibrous texture and irregular, curled shape.
